title: Symbol Search
summary: Searches symbols by name across the indexed projects
intro: Read this when you know or can guess a symbol name but not its file: Symbol Search finds types, methods and fields by name across the indexed projects, bound to Ctrl+Alt+T.

steps: Type part of the symbol name in the search box
Pick a result to open its declaration; the dialog also has a Usages view

pitfalls: a project DB IS the compile closure, so a hit is membership and a MISS is non-membership.

questions.ask: How do I search for a symbol from inside the IDE?
